characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Units within 8" of one or more friendly models with Aura of Power benefit from +2 Def and +2 Off.
Model parts with Mount are not affected.
see Arcane Engine unit entry.

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text: Whenever the bearer’s unit is targeted by an Order, it may immediately give that same Order (for free) to up to two Support Units within 8" (of itself).

characteristics.name: Armour Enchant
characteristics.$text: +1 Arm, and if the wearer is without Mount, it gains an additional +1 Arm. Immune (Flaming Attacks).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
A unit containing Blessings gains First Strike (Hatred). Model parts with Mount are not affected.
The model can cast the following three Bound Spells (3+), with Type: Caster, and Duration: One Turn. ullorUllor’s Blessing The target’s unit gains Aegis (5+, against Melee Attacks). sunnaSunna's Blessing The target’s unit gains Flaming Attacks.
Each enemy unit in contact with the target’s unit when the spell is cast, suffers D6 hits with Str 4, AP 0, Flaming Attacks and Magical Attacks. volundVolund’s Blessing The target’s unit gains Zeal.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
At the start of each friendly Player Turn, each model with Imperial Authority may select one of the following effects, called Orders, and apply it to a single unit, with Duration: One Turn. The target unit must:
  • Be a Parent or Support Unit.
  • Be the model’s own unit, or be within range of the model’s Commanding Presence or Beacon of Courage (if it has one of these rules).
  • The chosen target cannot already be under the effect of an Order. On The Double!The target gains +1" Cha and +2" Mob. Steady, Men! The target gains Disciplined, and its Courage Tests gain Minimised. Ready! Aim! Fire!The target gains Accurate. Brace For Impact!The target gains Fight in Extra Rank and Shoot in Extra Rank.

characteristics.$text: The unit replaces Parent Unit with Support Unit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model part is equipped with a Hand Weapon enchanted with The Light of Sonnstahl, and can only take up to 50 pts of Magic Items.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: During Pre-game Selections, if a Caster from the Empire of Sonnstahl either selects the Hereditary Spell or gains it by any other means, it must instead choose a single Path of Magic from the ones available to it other than its chosen Path: the Caster gains the Apprentice Spell(#1) from that Path as a Learned Spell.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model’s rolls for Random Movement gain Maximised.
The model may choose not to move despite having Random Movement.
The model cannot choose to Pursue –– unless it is Charging, in which case it must Pursue (including Overrun).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
A unit containing a model with this rule is referred to as a Support Unit.
Support Units within 8" of a Parent Unit gain Resolute.
During the opponent’s Charge Phase, Support Units may perform one of the following actions:
  • Supporting Fire: the Support Unit may perform an out of sequence Shooting Attack towards an enemy unit that has successfully performed a Charge Move against a friendly Parent Unit within 8".
Apply the normal rules for Shooting Attacks, ignoring the Parent Unit for Cover and Line of Sight purposes.
  • Counter Charge: after enemy units finish their Charge Moves, Support Units within 8" of a successfully charged friendly Parent Unit may choose one enemy unit that has Charged the Parent Unit and declare a Charge, applying the normal rules for Charging (Line of Sight, Front Arc, rolls for Charge Range, etc.).
A Support Unit that performs a Counter Charge is considered to have at most one Proper Rank for the purpose of inflicting Surrounded, with Duration: Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: At the beginning of step 3.6 of the Battle Setup (Move Vanguarding Units), choose one friendly Parent or Support Unit within 8" of a unit containing Wilderness Guides: the chosen unit gains Vanguard (3" Mob).

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Aegis (3+, against Flaming Attacks), Aegis (5+), and Distracting (1), and automatically fails all Regeneration Saves.
